card.name: Start of a split drug or medical word
card.fires_on: The first short piece of a word that is split into parts, such as D in Dibasic or Dipyridamole, Pr in Pravastatin, Mon in Monotherapy. It usually comes right after a comma, 'and', or a heading colon in drug-label text.

modes.label: Drug name openings
modes.description: First piece of a drug name split into parts, often in a list or after 'and'.

modes.label: Statin list items
modes.description: The Pr start of pravastatin in a list of statins.

modes.label: Other medical word openings
modes.description: First piece of a clinical term such as monotherapy or odynophagia.
